procedure.method: Independent fresh assessment. Verified byte counts and SHA-256 of the explicitly pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, helper scripts, five selected manifests and all fifteen poster files. The packet has no source assets or protected layouts. Viewed the exact files through tools.view_image({path,detail:'original'}), emitting the returned image with original detail. Five successive functions.exec calls each awaited native, usage720, then thumbnail320 for M1 through M5 in packet order; I visually inspected the displayed results. All fifteen initial views were completed before recording first raw copy transcriptions, assigning any image score or judging set diversity. No contact sheet, OCR, image transformation, revisit, peer review, author explanation, unpinned embedded path or session ID was used. PNG IHDR reads independently confirmed dimensions and opaque RGB color type 2; those reads did not replace visual inspection.

space.location: central heading edges and lower text blocks
